title: Delivery Charge Carried Over to a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Exchange
content:
The delivery charge carried over is then added, because the charge paid on the line bought one delivery of goods the customer is giving back and the replacement is delivered again at no further charge, so the share of it the first delivery did not earn goes back with the difference. Where a delivery charge stands against the line and the schedule does not refund the delivery charge, the delivery carry share of that charge is added. Where a delivery charge stands against the line and the schedule refunds the delivery charge, the whole of that charge is added. In any other case nothing is added.

The delivery carry share is 50 per cent.

## What is read

The charge read is the delivery charge standing against that order line on Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment. Whether the Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule the line falls under refunds a delivery charge is read from the schedule's own terms:

| Return schedule | Does the schedule refund the delivery charge? |
| --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | no |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | yes |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | no |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | no |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | no |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | no |

| A delivery charge against the line | The schedule | Amount added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than nothing | does not refund the delivery charge | 50 per cent of that charge, rounded to the cent |
| more than nothing | refunds the delivery charge | the whole of that charge |
| nothing at all | either way | nothing |

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*A delivery charge of 79.00 USD against the line, on a schedule that does not refund the delivery charge.* Fifty per cent of 79.00 USD is 39.50 USD, and 39.50 USD is added.

*A delivery charge of 79.99 USD against the line, on a schedule that does not refund it.* Fifty per cent of 79.99 USD is 39.995 USD, rounded to the cent, so 40.00 USD is added.

*A delivery charge of 79.00 USD against the line, on a schedule that does refund the delivery charge.* The whole 79.00 USD is added.

*No delivery charge standing against the line.* Nothing is added, whichever schedule the line falls under.
